Data Source: Our World in Data - Poverty ([World Bank (2026). Poverty and Inequality Platform (version 20260324_2021 and 20260324_2017) \[Data set\]. World Bank Group. https://pip.worldbank.org/.](https://pip.worldbank.org/))

# Visualization 1

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
owi_poverty <- read_csv("data/share-of-population-living-in-extreme-poverty.csv") 
View(owi_poverty)

poverty_world <- owi_poverty |>
  filter(Country == c("World", "World (excluding China)", "World (excluding India)"))
  
ggplot(data = poverty_world,
       mapping = aes(x = Year,
                     y = `Share below $3 a day`,
                     color = Country)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, shape = 16) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess",
              se = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2016, 2026, by = 1)) +
  theme_minimal()
  
  
  
```
